grades.quote: FLT.S and FLE.S perform what the IEEE 754-2008 standard refers to as _signaling_ comparisons: that is, they set the invalid operation exception flag if either input is NaN. FEQ.S performs a _quiet_ comparison: it only sets the invalid operation exception flag if either input is a signaling NaN.
grades.reason: Explains when comparisons record an invalid-operation flag, but not how software reads or clears accumulated flags.
Identifies where and under what conditions underflow and inexact causes are recorded, but does not explain reading or clearing accumulated status.
